headlines.title: ADB, 韓 성장전망 0.6%P 올려 3.2%

headlines.title: 산업부 " 대미투자 1호 텍사스 가스발전…2호 원전 ·3호 알래스카 LNG"
headlines.summary: 김정관 산업통상부 장관이 22일 국회 산업통상중소벤처기업위원회에서 '대한민국과 미합중국 간 전략적투자의 운영 및 관리를 위한 특별법'에 따른 대미투자 사전보고를 하고 있다. /연합뉴스 산업통상부가 대미 투자 프로젝트 1호 사업으로 텍사스주 엔시날 가스복합화력발전소 건설 사업을 보고한 것으로 알려졌다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 양도세 벽에 막힌 ‘ 승계 M&A ’… 수십년 기업 명맥 끊기나
headlines.summary: 비상장 중기 주식 매각 세율 최대 25% “양도세 내고나면 손에 쥐는 돈 없어” 매각가격·고용승계 등 암초에 표류도 기업 지속가능성 유지 수단 마련 시급 기술보증기금은 21일 서울 여의도 중소기업중앙회 K-비즈홀에서 열린 ‘2026 기업승계 M&A 브릿지 포럼’을 개최했다.  홍석희 기자 “회사를 팔아 노후자금을 마련하려 했는데 꿈도 못꿔요.

headlines.title: 정부, 국내도입 원유 ‘ 중동산 비중 ’ 절반 이하로 줄인다
headlines.summary: 중동外 수입시 발생 운임차액 지원금 현행 25%서 확대키로 미국·이란 전쟁에 따른 호르무즈 해협 운항 차질로 원유 수급 공급망에 큰 위기를 겪은 정부가 국내 도입 원유의 중동산 비중을 절반 이하로 줄이기로 했다.

headlines.title: 정부, 非중동 원유 수입부과금 환급 확대조치 재시행
headlines.summary: 정부가 중동 정세 불안에 따른 원유 수급 차질에 대응하기 위해 비(非)중동산 원유에 대한 수입부과금 환급 확대 조치를 재시행한다. 정부는 제6차 부담금운용심의위원회를 서면으로 열고 올해 9~12월 한시적으로 다변화 원유 수입부과금 환급 요건을 완화하고 환급 한도도 확대하기로 했다고 24일 밝혔다. 국제유가.

headlines.title: [금융현미경]유가·금리·경기… 추석 전후 韓 환율 향방 최대 변수는
headlines.summary: 유가 및 주요국 통화긴축 따른 달러·엔 등 움직임에 영향 반도체發 수출 호조 지속…환율 상승 제어 요인으로 원·달러 환율이 재차 1350원 선으로 내려앉았다. 유가 흐름이 환율 향방의 핵심 변수로 자리 잡은 상황에서 미·이란 간 긴장 완화 기대감, 사우디아라비아의 원유 수출 확대 기대감 등이 작용하며 유가가 하락한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.7% - Largest Upward Revision Among G20
key_headlines.summary: International organizations including OECD and ADB have significantly raised Korea's economic growth forecasts, driven by strong semiconductor exports and expected consumer recovery. However, inflation warnings at 3% remain a concern.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls to 1,350 Level as Oil Prices Decline
key_headlines.summary: The won strengthened against the dollar amid falling oil prices, influenced by easing US-Iran tensions and Saudi Arabia's expected crude export expansion. Oil price movements have become the key variable determining exchange rate direction.

key_headlines.title: Korea to Build 8 Nuclear Plants in US Including Korean APR1400 Reactors
key_headlines.summary: Korea and the US are jointly planning to construct 8 nuclear plants - 6 Westinghouse AP1000 units and 2 Korean APR1400 units - marking Korea's major entry into the American nuclear market. Additional costs and workforce securing remain the primary challenges.

key_headlines.title: September Consumer Price Inflation Drops to 2.9%, Down from 3% Range
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's September consumer price index rose 2.9% year-over-year, falling back below 3% due to increased agricultural supply ahead of Chuseok and government discount support, though core inflation remains elevated.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Transactions Concentrate on Sub-600 Million Won Prices Due to Policy Loan Cutoffs
key_headlines.summary: Over 22% of Seoul apartment transactions were below 600 million won in 2026, with buying pressure concentrated on properties eligible for policy loans like the Didimdol loan, reflecting affordability constraints and high jeonse prices.

sections.Hot Economy News: International institutions have significantly upgraded Korea's economic outlook, with OECD raising its 2026 growth forecast from 2.6% to 3.7%, the largest upward revision among G20 nations. The revision reflects strong semiconductor export performance and anticipated consumer recovery momentum. September's consumer inflation moderated to 2.9%, down from the previous 3% range, though core inflation remains sticky. The won strengthened to 1,350 per dollar as oil prices declined on expectations of US-Iran tension easing and Saudi crude export expansion. Korea is advancing plans to construct 8 nuclear power plants in the US, including 2 Korean APR1400 units, marking significant market penetration in the American nuclear sector.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea projects October consumer prices will remain elevated at around 3% as core category inflation continues to persist. Government debt exceeding twice GDP is constraining monetary policy flexibility, forcing difficult trade-offs between inflation control and interest rate management. High inflation expectations persist despite some moderation in September figures, with agricultural prices declining while energy costs remain elevated. Regional inflation data shows Chungbuk maintaining 3% inflation for five consecutive months, indicating sticky price pressures across regions. Policy authorities face challenges balancing growth support against persistent inflation as global interest rates rise and energy prices remain elevated.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI opened slightly lower at 0.47% decline despite easing US Treasury yields, while KOSDAQ recovered from early losses to reclaim the 900-level. US 10-year Treasury yields reached 5.34%, the highest in 24 years, driven by global bond selloffs amid inflation concerns and government debt expansion. Bond-type ETFs attracted 1.3 trillion won in inflows over the past month as investors seek higher yields in the elevated interest rate environment. Market sentiment remains cautious ahead of US September employment data, which could signal further Fed rate increases. Global stock markets showed mixed performance with semiconductor sector strength offsetting weakness in financial and transportation stocks.
sections.Industry & Technology: Global electric vehicle battery usage grew 19.7% in the first eight months of 2026, with Korean battery makers losing 3.9 percentage points of market share to Chinese competitors. Chinese battery makers are expanding overseas production while the government introduces consumption taxes and plans to eliminate export VAT refunds. Semiconductor equipment stocks rallied as the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 1.6% overnight, driven by continued AI data center investment demand. The government accelerated regulatory approval for Hyundai's EV factory conversion from 3+ years to 1 year, with fast-track designation for the Muan semiconductor industrial complex. Korean battery and semiconductor companies face intensifying competition from Chinese manufacturers despite strong global demand growth.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment transactions show 22% of deals below 600 million won due to policy loan cutoff thresholds, with buyers concentrating in sub-600 million won properties to qualify for programs like the Didimdol loan. Gangnam-area apartment prices declined sharply while Gangbuk remained resilient, breaking typical price coupling patterns. Price declines extended to Yongsan District, marking the expansion of weakness from the Gangnam 3-gu area as luxury property weakness spreads to premium locations. Seoul overall apartment prices recorded 86 consecutive weeks of gains, setting a record for longest continuous appreciation period. US mortgage rates surged to 7.28% amid rising inflation and government debt concerns, diminishing housing purchase capacity for American consumers.
sections.International Economy: Former President Trump criticized the Federal Reserve for September rate increases despite strong US GDP data revision to 2.2% annualized growth, pressuring the Fed to hold or cut rates before midterm elections. European luxury automakers are redirecting focus to the US market with large SUVs after struggling in China, with some considering expanded US-based production. The Trump administration pressured Europe to release strategic diesel reserves to lower fuel prices ahead of the November midterm elections. Korea's trade representative sought US commitment to honor the 15% tariff agreement and accelerated FTA negotiations with the US and EU. Global trade tensions remain elevated as the US administration pursues protectionist policies ahead of critical midterm elections.
sections.AI & Economy: Korea's exports reached a record 814.5 billion dollars in the first nine months of 2026, surpassing last year's entire annual export total of 709.3 billion dollars, with September semiconductor exports hitting 60.3 billion dollars for the first time. AI data center investments drove surging semiconductor demand and prices, with exports expected to reach 1 trillion dollars by year-end. LG CNS partnered with General Atlantic for joint investment in enterprise software and AI companies, expanding Korea's AI technology footprint globally. KT unveiled a medical AI standard model for hospitals with 24-hour AI voice bot support, aligning with the government's AI basic healthcare initiative. Strong semiconductor and AI-driven export momentum positions Korea favorably, though concentration risk in the semiconductor sector remains a concern.
sections.Others: Dunamu expanded Upbit Data Lab's AI-based market information services to provide enhanced trading insights. Gwanak Research Institute secured 300 million won in investment funding to deploy AI decision-making engines for banking, insurance, and public finance sectors. The Korea Customs Service eliminated caps on informant reward amounts and introduced progressive incentive structures up to 3x multipliers to encourage voluntary reporting of smuggling and tariff evasion. The government announced Korea's 200 billion dollar US investment plan including nuclear plants, AI data centers, and Alaska LNG project participation. Daejeon City appointed three master craftspeople in food processing, ceramics, and baking sectors to support skilled technology preservation and advancement.
